_meta.description: SEDM domain structures extracted from the Conceptual Model document. These structures exist only in prose and supplement the CEDS Map CSV which provides the element-level data.
_meta.source: SEDM Conceptual Model.md, Sections 0.0, 1.0, 3.0-3.6, 4.1, Appendix C

ontologicalClasses.name: Time
ontologicalClasses.definition: A standard way of documenting a point in time, duration between start and end date, or a time period

ontologicalClasses.name: Person
ontologicalClasses.definition: A human being, alive or deceased

ontologicalClasses.name: Organization
ontologicalClasses.definition: A group that people can be a part of

ontologicalClasses.name: Role
ontologicalClasses.definition: A relationship a person has with an organization for a particular period of time

ontologicalClasses.name: Resource
ontologicalClasses.definition: A digital or physical asset that can be drawn on by a person or organization

ontologicalClasses.name: Event
ontologicalClasses.definition: A class that has attributes of a person, org, role, or resource that occurred or changed at or over a particular time

complianceCategories.name: Identification
complianceCategories.description: Child Find - proactive identification, location, and evaluation of all children suspected of having disabilities

complianceCategories.name: Initial Referral and Evaluation
complianceCategories.description: Process from referral through parental consent to completed evaluation within 60 days

complianceCategories.name: IEP Team Meeting and Eligibility Determination
complianceCategories.description: Initial IEP team meeting and specific disability eligibility determination

complianceCategories.name: Individual Education Plans
complianceCategories.description: Development of IEP including PLAAFP, measurable annual goals, services, accommodations, and transition planning

complianceCategories.name: Services/Programming
complianceCategories.description: Delivery of special education services, related services, and supplementary aids in appropriate settings

complianceCategories.name: Discipline
complianceCategories.description: Disciplinary actions, interim removals, manifestation determinations, and educational services after removal

complianceCategories.name: Progress Monitoring
complianceCategories.description: Ongoing assessment and observation to measure progress toward IEP goals

complianceCategories.name: Academic Performance
complianceCategories.description: State assessment participation and performance for students with disabilities

complianceCategories.name: Issue Resolution
complianceCategories.description: Parent complaints, surrogate assignment, due process hearings, mediation, and written decisions

complianceCategories.name: Annual Review
complianceCategories.description: Annual IEP review requirement - review due dates and completion tracking

complianceCategories.name: IEP Transfer and PS Transition Planning
complianceCategories.description: IEP transfer between districts, transition planning for post-secondary beginning at age 16

complianceCategories.name: Completion
complianceCategories.description: IEP completion, parent consent withdrawn, graduation, dropout tracking

complianceCategories.name: Staffing
complianceCategories.description: Special education teacher qualifications, paraprofessional status, certification, and workforce metrics

complianceCategories.name: Facilities
complianceCategories.description: Physical facilities and settings for special education service delivery

complianceCategories.name: Financial
complianceCategories.description: Financial requirements and reporting for IDEA funding

complianceCategories.name: Oversight
complianceCategories.description: State systemic improvement plan, parent participation surveys, noncompliance correction

ideaIndicators.name: Graduation
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of youths with IEPs graduating from high school with a regular diploma

ideaIndicators.name: Dropout
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of youths with IEPs dropping out of high school

ideaIndicators.name: State Assessments Participation & Performance
ideaIndicators.description: Participation rate and proficiency rate for children with IEPs on statewide assessments, including gap analysis

ideaIndicators.name: Discipline
ideaIndicators.description: Rates of suspension/expulsion, significant discrepancy by race/ethnicity

ideaIndicators.name: Educational Environment Ages 6-21
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of children with IEPs aged 6-21 served inside regular class 80%+ of day, less than 40%, or in separate settings

ideaIndicators.name: Educational Environment Ages 3-5
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of children with IEPs aged 3-5 in regular early childhood program, separate class, or home

ideaIndicators.name: Early Childhood Outcomes
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of preschool children ages 3-5 with IEPs who demonstrate improvement in social-emotional skills, knowledge acquisition, and appropriate behaviors

ideaIndicators.name: Parent Participation
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of parents with a child receiving special education services who report that schools facilitated parent involvement

ideaIndicators.name: Disproportionality by Race/Ethnicity
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of LEAs with disproportionate representation of racial and ethnic groups in special education due to inappropriate identification

ideaIndicators.name: Disproportionality by Specific Disability
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of LEAs with disproportionate representation of racial and ethnic groups in specific disability categories due to inappropriate identification

ideaIndicators.name: Child Find/Timely Evaluations
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of children who were evaluated within 60 days of receiving parental consent for initial evaluation or state-established timeframe

ideaIndicators.name: Early Childhood Transition
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of children referred by Part C prior to age 3, found eligible for Part B, with IEP developed and implemented by third birthday

ideaIndicators.name: Secondary Transition
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of youth with IEPs aged 16+ with measurable, annually updated IEP goals and appropriate transition assessment, services, and courses

ideaIndicators.name: Post School Outcomes
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of youth no longer in secondary school who had IEPs, grouped by enrollment in higher education, competitive employment, or other employment

ideaIndicators.name: General Supervision - Resolution Sessions
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of hearing requests that went to resolution sessions that were resolved through settlement agreements

ideaIndicators.name: Mediation
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of mediations held resulting in mediation agreements

ideaIndicators.name: State Systemic Improvement Plan
ideaIndicators.description: SPP/APR includes comprehensive, ambitious, yet achievable multi-year SSIP with stakeholder engagement for improving results

ideaIndicators.name: Noncompliance Correction
ideaIndicators.description: Percent of findings of noncompliance corrected within one year of identification

standardEventMilestones.description: Proposed CEDS entity for tracking IDEA compliance dates. Each milestone has a date, type, and description.

proposedElements.name: IDEA Standard Event Milestone Date
proposedElements.definition: The effective date of the Standard Event Milestone

proposedElements.name: IDEA Standard Event Milestone Type
proposedElements.definition: The type of IDEA Standard Event Milestone recorded

proposedElements.name: IDEA Standard Event Milestone Description
proposedElements.definition: Description of the Standard Event Milestone

milestoneTypes.name: Parental Consent for Implementing IEP Given
Parental Consent for Implementing IEP Decline

iepComponents.name: Present Levels of Academic Achievement and Functional Performance
iepComponents.description: Current academic and functional performance, how disability affects involvement in general education curriculum

iepComponents.name: Measurable Annual Goals
iepComponents.description: SMART goals for academic achievement and functional performance

subcomponents.name: Benchmarks or Short-Term Objectives
subcomponents.note: Required for students taking alternate assessments

subcomponents.name: Progress Measurement Description
subcomponents.note: How and when progress reports will be provided

iepComponents.name: Special Education and Related Services
iepComponents.description: Instruction, related services, and supplementary aids tailored to child's needs

iepComponents.name: Service Delivery
iepComponents.description: Frequency, location, and duration of each service

iepComponents.name: Accommodations and Modifications
iepComponents.description: Adjustments for classroom instruction and assessments

iepComponents.name: Consideration of Special Factors
iepComponents.description: Behavioral issues, limited English proficiency, visual/hearing impairment, assistive technology

iepComponents.name: Extent of Placement with Nondisabled Peers
iepComponents.description: Least Restrictive Environment determination and justification for any removal from general education

iepComponents.name: Transition Services
iepComponents.description: Post-secondary goals and transition services beginning at age 16

iepComponents.name: Parent and Student Participation
iepComponents.description: Parent as equal IEP team member, student involvement in transition planning, translation requirements

iepComponents.name: Extended School Year Services
iepComponents.description: Services beyond regular school year if needed to receive FAPE, based on regression risk

values.name: Setting
values.description: How the environment is made accessible for instruction and assessment

values.name: Scheduling
values.description: How time demands and schedules may be adjusted

values.name: Assessment
values.description: How students show what they know

useCases.description: IDEA child count EdFacts report - unduplicated count of children ages 5-21 with IEPs on state child count date
